sourceReferences.snippet: 7. Review of Possible Updates for FY27 Budget: Mr. Haffner asked Mr. Blakey if the county was sending out budget reports earlier this year. Mr. Blakey replied that there had been some preliminary talks but no official date updates. He said the plans so far had involved devising an average for a budget using a different technique that he thought departments would like better than the current budget process. He said part of that process would be the budget coming sooner rather than later so everyone had more time to get things in order by the first of the year.

sourceReferences.snippet: TMP-8249 Action Item Initiation of a proposed ordinance amending Washoe County Code (“WCC”) Chapter 45 to set the matter for an introduction and first reading of the ordinance on January 23, 2024, and, if supported, set a public hearing for second reading and possible adoption of the ordinance on February 13, 2024. If passed, the proposed ordinance will modify: 1) the definition of “child care” found in WCC 45.010(5) to mirror the definition of “child care facility” found in Nevada Revised Statutes (“NRS”) 432A.024; 2) the definition of “division director” and selection process thereof in WCC 45.010(4) and WCC 45.020(2)(b), respectively; and 3) the composition of the Washoe County Human Services Agency (“WCHSA”) in WCC 45.020(1) to reflect the addition of new divisions within WCHSA.
